The 2nd floor has 10 apartments, with the rest being shared space with an indoor pool, sports room and cafe area. From the 3rd to the 25th floor there are 30 units per floor: 28 2-bedroom units and 2 3-bedroom units at the two corners of the U wings, with views of the sea, the city, the square or the Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son). About 1,900 residents are expected.
